description: Verify that DUT does NOT reassemble when an internal fragment is missing — frag offset=0 (MF=1) + frag offset=2 (MF=0) leave a hole at octets 8..15 so reassembly must abort (RFC 791 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Unlike IPV4_REASSEMBLY_06 (missing fragment 0), here fragment 0 is present but a middle fragment is missing. The IP/ICMP header is reconstructable but the payload is incomplete — DUT must still abort reassembly rather than emit a torn message.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: fragment at offset=0 (MF=1)
2. Tester → DUT: fragment at offset=2 (MF=0)
   ⇒ Hole at octets 8..15 remains unfilled.

3. Observation (extended):
   • DUT → Tester: nothing

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any Echo Reply.

[Fail condition]
Fail_dut_replied — DUT replied despite the missing middle fragment. Indicates reassembly delivered partial data upstream.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently abandoned the gap-holed reassembly — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_replied: DUT replied despite a missing middle fragment — partial data delivered upstream
